node.title: Re: unequal treatment
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
jdporter posts an indignity directed at me.

I understand how you took his post. But I think both parties should consider:

  • [wp://Robustness principle]: Be conservative in what you send, be liberal in what you accept.
  • [https://www.fastcompany.com/3036748/why-its-so-hard-to-detect-emotion-in-emails-and-texts|Emotions and intent are difficult to communicate online].

IMHO, [jdporter] could have been more clear in what he meant, and you could consider that maybe he didn't mean it as an insult.
